**sdd/issue-256-b2/apply-progress**

**What**: B2 Half 1 (Antigravity harness adapter) fully implemented — Phases 1-6 all 24 tasks [x], Phase 7 gate baseline green. Two post-apply fresh-context findings fixed in-PR: (1) dispatch-test hermeticity smell, (2) CP-B2 inaugural-read compiler-correctness bug (relative links break when spliced into repo-root AGENTS.md). Half 2 (#247 baptism) explicitly NOT executed (out of scope, downstream, human-operated). CP-B2 checkpoint report already committed by the coordinator (`e129aad`, openspec/changes/issue-256-b2/checkpoint-report.md — not authored by this agent).

**Why**: Ships antigravity.mjs as the 3rd SDD_HARNESS backend (n=3, zero cli.mjs change), compiling a self-contained, LINK-CORRECT AGENTS.md from brain's 5 canonical docs (never hand-authored, per REQ-B2-2), classified in governance.ignoreList per owner ruling #601 (chain-guarded generated artifact), plus the baptism runbook doc preparing (not executing) Half 2.

**Where** (6 commits by this agent on feat/issue-256-b2, base 565a628; `e129aad` checkpoint-report.md is coordinator-authored, sits between commits 5 and 6):
1. `3e14b41` feat(harness): antigravity.mjs (compileAgentsMd pure compiler + SOURCE_DOCS frozen array + init() seam-injected) + antigravity.test.mjs + antigravity.drift.test.mjs + generated AGENTS.md.
2. `594a03e` chore(governance): brain.config.json ignoreList += literal "AGENTS.md"; diff-size-count.mjs doctrine comment extended per #601 Pin 2; governance-ignorelist.test.mjs extended.
3. `f999433` feat(installer): managed-paths.mjs += literal 'AGENTS.md'; managed-paths.test.mjs extended.
4. `7f556c5` docs(sdd): openspec/changes/issue-256-b2/ artifacts + runbook-baptism.md.
5. `ee627ca` test(harness): FIX #1 — hermeticity. The end-to-end dispatch test called `dispatch('antigravity','init',[])` with ZERO seam overrides, performing a REAL write to tracked AGENTS.md as an npm-test side effect — masked by file ordering, would silently HEAL a hand-edited AGENTS.md before the drift-guard could see it. Fixed by injecting a capturing fake `_writeAgents` (real `_readDoc`/repoRoot still exercised — real docs read, n=3 dispatch still proven, but write lands in memory only).
6. `f42e6a8` fix(harness): FIX #2 — CP-B2 inaugural-read finding (owner ruling). `compileAgentsMd()` spliced source docs' relative markdown links VERBATIM — correct only from each doc's OWN location, broken when spliced into AGENTS.md at repo root (e.g. brain/HOME.md's `../docs/adoption.md` resolves OUTSIDE the repo from root). Antigravity follows the file (Exp 4) — real consumer defect. Added `rebaseRelativeLinks()`: rewrites each relative link's TARGET only (never visible text) via `path.posix.join(sourceDir, rawPath)` then `path.posix.relative(emitDir, resolved)`, threading each SOURCE_DOCS entry's own directory through `compileAgentsMd`'s per-section splice. Skips scheme URLs (`^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:`), pure anchors (`#...`), and already-root-relative (`/...`) — regex `/\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)\s]+)((?:\s+"[^"]*")?)\)/g` extracts text/url/title, preserves `#anchor` suffixes across rebasing. Regenerated committed AGENTS.md via deliberate CLI act — 36 links rebased (e.g. `../docs/adoption.md`→`docs/adoption.md`, `core/methodology/X.md`→`brain/core/methodology/X.md`, `project/...`→`brain/project/...`).

**Learned**:
- Real repo root for antigravity.mjs is 4 dirname-ups (`../../../..`), matching gentle-ai.mjs, not cli.mjs's 3-up.
- JS destructuring-parameter defaults can't forward-reference a later param's default in the same pattern — resolve fallbacks in the function body instead.
- **Test-suite side-effect trap**: an end-to-end dispatch test exercising a REAL write seam with zero overrides can silently mutate tracked files AND heal drift-guard evidence on reorder — always inject the write seam even when today's output is deterministic-identical.
- **Verbatim splice ≠ correct splice for markdown**: byte-for-byte reproduction of TEXT content (REQ-B2-2's Tier-table requirement) is compatible with REBASING structural elements like link targets — "verbatim" binds the prose, not the hyperlink graph. `path.posix.join` already normalizes (`path.posix.join('brain', '../docs/adoption.md')` → `'docs/adoption.md'` directly, no separate `.normalize()` call needed).
- `node:path`'s `posix` named export (`import { posix as posixPath } from 'node:path'`) is the right tool for repo-relative unix-style path math regardless of host OS — used instead of `path.resolve` (which requires an absolute anchor and would silently pull in `process.cwd()`).
- Counted diff progression: 146 (initial) → unchanged after hermeticity fix (test-only) → **204** after the link-rebase fix (`antigravity.mjs` grew ~58 counted lines for the rebase logic; `antigravity.test.mjs` grew but stays budget-free). Well under 400, no size:exception needed. Command: `git diff --numstat 565a628 HEAD | node brain/scripts/vcs/diff-size-count.mjs`.
- Definitive hermeticity proof done on the CLEAN COMMITTED tree (not mid-session): `git status --short AGENTS.md` empty before AND after a full `npm test` run.
- Pre-existing `brain:audit` FAILs (04ae992, 8d60661) confirmed unchanged throughout.
- `.memory/**` bulk export from `memory:share` and the pre-existing untracked `docs/inbox/PLAN-adapters-v3.md` remain deliberately uncommitted (PLAN-DEVIATION, orchestrator/human territory).
- Task 7.3 (CP-B2 inaugural read) and 7.5 (STOP declaration) are orchestrator/human steps — the finding that drove fix #2 CAME FROM that inaugural read, confirming the read happened and had teeth.
- Half 2 (#247 baptism) NOT started, NOT executed.
